name: Capstone Project
description:
Problem identification and industry-relevant use-case selection.
System-level specification and performance metric definition.
Dataset acquisition, preprocessing, and validation strategy.
Selection and training of AI/ML models for target applications.
Algorithm–hardware co-design and architectural trade-off analysis.
Fixed-point modeling, quantization, and hardware feasibility checks.
RTL/HLS implementation and integration of ML algorithms.
Functional verification, simulation, and timing/power analysis.
FPGA/ASIC prototyping and real-time performance evaluation.
Technical documentation, design review, and final project demonstration.
